task.description: Design and update comprehensive OBS-03 test specifications and test cases covering all requirement acceptance criteria and edge cases for audit logging. Ensure coverage includes: successful POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE writes create audit records with required fields; read-only GET does not create audit records; atomicity/rollback behavior when audit insert cannot persist; immutability guarantees (no modify/delete path); GET /audit filtering by actor_id/resource_type/resource_id/from/to; API-06-compatible pagination/ordering behavior; and canceled-token post-auth action auditing. Produce/update tests/specs artifact(s) and any required test source files so TEST-RUNNER can execute and verify OBS-03 deterministically.
acceptance_criteria: OBS-03 acceptance criteria and edge cases are mapped to explicit test cases
Test specs are updated under tests/specs with clear traceability to OBS-03
Integration/unit test files required for execution are created or updated
No ambiguous expected outcomes remain for TEST-RUNNER

result.summary: Test specs and deterministic integration tests for OBS-03 were produced with explicit traceability for all acceptance criteria and edge cases.
